macros.name: boxnamedmpimage
macros.doc: Puts the image named name in box box-nr.

macros.name: boxnextmpimage
macros.doc: Puts the next unretrieved image in box box-nr.

macros.name: closemetapostinstance
macros.doc: An instance can be closed with \closemetapostinstance \id.

macros.name: debugmetapost
macros.doc: You can enable (global) debugging by saying debug_pdf to metapost, \debugmetapost to tex or M.enable_debugging() to lua. This will write out a summary of metapost object information to the pdf file, just above the pdf instructions that object was translated into.

macros.name: directmetapost
macros.doc: Every call to \directmetapost opens and closes a separate metapost instance.

macros.name: directmetapost
macros.doc: Every call to \directmetapost opens and closes a separate metapost instance.

macros.name: getallmpimages
macros.doc: Say \remainingmpimages \id for the number of images not yet retrieved and \getallmpimages \id to insert all remaining images.

macros.name: getnamedmpimage
macros.doc: Retrieves an image by name and writes it to the current node list.

macros.name: getnextmpimage
macros.doc: Writes the first unretrieved image to the current node list.

macros.name: newmetapostinstance
macros.doc: You can define a new persistent metapost instance with \newmetapostinstance [ options ] \id.

macros.doc: You can define a new persistent metapost instance with \newmetapostinstance [ options ] \id.

macros.name: remainingmpimages
macros.doc: Say \remainingmpimages \id for the number of images not yet retrieved and \getallmpimages \id to insert all remaining images.

macros.name: runmetapostimage
macros.doc: \runmetapostimage \id { code } will add beginfig ... endfig; to your code and write the resulting image immediately to the current list.
